description: Search across all local Google OKF v0.2 and Obsidian Markdown meeting transcripts and notes by keyword, speaker name, tag, or ISO date range. Use this first for cross-vault discovery when you do not yet know the exact note path or title; prefer okf_read_note once you have a specific file path, slug, or [[wiki-link]], and prefer okf_list_action_items for task checklists. Read-only and 100% offline (zero network calls, no file modifications). Returns a relevance-ranked JSON array of matching notes with snippets and open action counts, or an empty array [] if no notes match.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower-bound ISO-8601 date filter (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01"). Notes without a date field are retained unless excluded by other filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked meeting notes to return (clamped between 1 and 50).

query.description: Space-separated search keywords matched case-insensitively against note titles, [[wiki-links]], and body text (e.g. "Q4 roadmap pricing"). Leave empty to filter solely by speaker, tag, or date range.

speaker.description: Case-insensitive substring filter matching YAML frontmatter speakers or inline transcript speaker labels (e.g. "Alice").

tag.description: Case-insensitive substring filter matching YAML frontmatter tags (e.g. "local-ai" or "roadmap").

toDate.description: Inclusive upper-bound ISO-8601 date filter (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-30").

name: okf_search_meetings
title: Search Local Meeting Notes & Transcripts
